task: Browse the list of Civil Division forms.
agent_final_answer:
Browsed the Civil Division "Documents and Forms" page (justice.gov/civil/documents-and-forms-0). The list of Civil Division forms is organized into these categories:

General / Top-level:
- Civil Division Enforcement Priorities
- Legal Representation Letters
- Standard Form 95 (used to present FTCA claims for property damage, personal injury, or death)
- Judgment Fund Payment Forms: FMS 194 (Judgment Fund Transmittal), FMS 196 (Judgment Fund Award Data Sheet), FMS 197 (Judgment Fund Voucher for Payment)

Commercial Litigation Documents and Forms:
- Fraud Section: The False Claims Act: A Primer; False Claims Act Statistics
- Corporate / Financial Litigation Section: Student Loan Bankruptcy guidance, Appendix A (Attestation Form), Appendix B (Sample Scenario)
- Intellectual Property Section: relevant U.S.C. citations (28 U.S.C. 1498, 35 U.S.C. 271(a), 22 U.S.C. 2356, 19 U.S.C. 1337, 42 U.S.C. 2223, 35 U.S.C. 183); Trademark Amendments Act of 1999
- National Courts Section: Appellate Practice; Trial Practice
- Office of Foreign Litigation

Office of Immigration Litigation Documents and Forms:
- OIL-Appellate Section: Immigration Litigation Bulletin; Immigration Law Advisor
- OIL-District Court Section

Torts Branch Documents and Forms:
- Aviation, Space and Admiralty Litigation Section
- Constitutional & Specialized Tort Litigation Section: 28 C.F.R. 50.15 and 50.16; Radiation Exposure Compensation Act (RECA) forms (Onsite Participant Claim Form, Downwinder Claim Form, Uranium Mine Employee Claim Form, Ore Transporter Claim Form, Uranium Mill Employee Claim Form)
- Environmental Tort Litigation Section
- Federal Tort Claims Act Litigation Section: Annuity Broker Declaration; Standard Form 95

Page last updated September 30, 2025.
